privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your data
privacy.alert: Privacy Policy: We do NOT store your receipt images or full content. OCR usage metrics are anonymized for cost tracking only. All receipt data stays on your device.

account.title: Account & data protection
account.anonymousBody: Purchase history is not linked to an account. With anonymous-only use, recovery after uninstall cannot be guaranteed.
account.linkedPendingBody: Some records are waiting for cloud backup. Original receipt images are not uploaded or restored.
account.protectedBody: Structured purchase data is linked to your Apple account and can be restored on a new device (images excluded).
account.emptyBody: No local purchase records on this device.
account.alertProtectOk: This account is now protected with Apple.
account.alertProtectConflict: This Apple ID is already linked to another account. This version cannot automatically merge two purchase histories. Your local data was not changed.
account.alertProtectUidChanged: Linking failed unexpectedly (user identity changed). No data migration was performed.
account.alertProtectFailed: Linking failed. Please try again later.
account.alertRestoreBlockedLocal: This device already has purchase records, so another account cannot be restored here.
account.alertRestoreBlockedOutbox: Pending local backup changes block restore.
account.alertRestoreFailed: Signed in with Apple, but restore failed. You can retry later. Local data remains safe.
account.alertSignInFailed: Apple sign-in failed. Please try again later.
